overview: Add OPML import via file upload so users can bulk-add feeds to their recent list without manual entry.
goals: Allow users to upload an OPML file from the UI
Parse feed URLs from OPML and add them to recent feeds
successMetrics: Uploading a valid OPML file populates recent feeds in under 2 seconds
Invalid OPML files show a clear error without altering recent feeds
openQuestions: Should imported feeds replace existing recents or merge with them? (default: merge and dedupe)

routes.name: Viewer
routes.purpose: Upload OPML and manage recent feeds

uiNotes: Add a file upload control labeled 'Import OPML'
Show success and error status in the existing status banner
Imported feeds should appear in the recent feeds list

importFormat.description: OPML XML with <outline> elements containing xmlUrl attributes

rules: Parse xmlUrl attributes from OPML outlines and ignore duplicates
Merge imported URLs with existing recents and keep at most 5
Invalid files must not modify stored recent feeds

stories.title: Add OPML file upload and parsing
stories.description: As a user, I want to upload an OPML file so my feeds are added automatically.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a file input in the UI labeled 'Import OPML'
Parse OPML XML client-side and extract feed URLs from xmlUrl attributes
Merge imported URLs into recent feeds (dedupe, most-recent-first, max 5)
Example: importing an OPML file with 3 feeds adds them to the recent list
Negative case: uploading a non-OPML file shows an error and does not change recent feeds

stories.title: Test OPML import behavior
stories.description: As a developer, I want tests that verify OPML imports and error handling.
acceptanceCriteria: Add tests that simulate importing valid OPML and confirm recent feeds update
Add tests that simulate invalid OPML and confirm recent feeds do not change
Example: valid OPML adds URLs and persists them to localStorage
Negative case: invalid OPML leaves localStorage unchanged
